note: Size and length reference used by the wearability score and the customer size guide. Every table names its evidence level: OWNER_PUBLISHED (from Beyond Style's own size-guide creative), OWNER_CATALOGUE_STATED (from the owner's catalogue/ads, not measured on this platform), INDUSTRY_STANDARD (common trade chart). Nothing here is measured by the platform.

bracelet_size_guide.how_to_measure: Wrap a measuring tape or a thin strip of paper around the wrist just above the wrist bone, snug but not tight, and read in centimetres. Measure at the end of the day; if between two sizes choose the larger.
bracelet_size_guide.rule: recommended bracelet length = wrist measurement + 1 to 2 cm depending on preferred fit

necklace_lengths_cm.note: Standard trade chart (35–80 cm / 16–30 in). Third-party guide graphics supplied by the owner are registered by hash in golden case BS-GPC-0028 and not stored.

chain_catalogue.note: Men's 925 silver chain profiles as stated in Beyond Style catalogue creatives (golden case BS-GPC-0017). Weights are the owner's stated values per length; a name pendant's weight is added on top when quoting.
